How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer reviews, including Product Star Ratings, help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we do not use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things such as how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyses reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    I purchased the navy-colored T-shirt previously, and I was very satisfied with it. The fabric quality, GSM, and fitting were excellent. Based on that experience, I ordered the same T-shirt in white.

    Unfortunately, the white T-shirt is completely different. The fabric is very thin, the GSM is much lower, and after the first wash it became longer and lost its shape. The quality is far below what I received the first time.

    This inconsistency is very disappointing. It feels like the products are being sourced from different manufacturers with different quality standards. The quality control team should have identified this before the product was shipped.

    I am not satisfied with this purchase. If a return or replacement is possible, I would like to return this product. Otherwise, I will have to leave an honest review so that other customers are aware of this quality issue.
